digest.component_or_area: eval/calibration surface for project code-review criteria
propositions: The eval/calibration surface does not admit activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id only accepts static built-in physical ids and lacks repository context.

_code_review_prompt_id should accept an optional repo_root and, when provided, admit every logical id from effective_criteria mapped via criterion_prompt_id under gate_key code_review while retaining built-ins.
calibrate_criterion should select the code-review arm only when repo_root is not None and the criterion is in effective_criteria, otherwise keep the unchanged plan-review branch.
A plan-review criterion with a non-None repo root must still follow the unchanged plan-review calibration path.
An active project code-review criterion with no eval spec should raise a located EvalError containing the logical criterion id and the eval-spec path.
An inactive project physical id must be rejected, and code-review-tests without repo_root must remain admitted, proving logical-to-physical mapping rather than raw comparison.
